commands.command: TBD: build or use a multi-seed hidden-envelope probe aggregator over several probe seeds, checkpoints, and target envelopes
commands.name: m107_multiseed_hidden_envelope_gate

decision_rule: Before any PPO continuation from M105, require a hidden-envelope gate that aggregates across probe seeds and reports mean, worst-case, and pass fractions for braking, lateral, and yaw envelope lift.
failure_criteria: single probe seed results are treated as admission evidence
fresh probe seeds produce negative braking or lateral lift
the aggregate gate cannot distinguish model instability from probe-corpus variance
the gate changes deployable actor inputs or uses hidden physics at inference
hypothesis: M106 showed that behavior dependence repeats but hidden-envelope lift is probe-seed fragile. A multi-seed aggregate gate is needed before deciding whether M105 needs a stronger objective or just a more stable proof surface.
success_criteria: aggregate hidden-envelope metrics are computed across multiple probe seeds
mean and worst-case lift are reported per target
the gate pre-registers pass/fail thresholds before PPO continuation
M105 checkpoints are evaluated under the aggregate gate
the result is recorded in docs, scoreboard, queue, and status
